facebook.content:
Family – We are called to be a beacon of God’s covenant love in our homes.  
Lord, we declare that every household under our care walks in divine unity, forgiveness, and purpose.  The Spirit of peace reigns, every word spoken builds up, and every conflict dissolves by Your power.  We claim Your provision for each need and declare that our families reflect the Kingdom of Christ.  

Drop a 🙏 if you stand with this, or share your own request below.
